why: Clean private limited company; every field and document agrees.
Form says 'Sharma Electricals', bank says 'Rajesh Sharma'. Looks like a mismatch, but the GST certificate links the trade name to the proprietor and the PAN is an individual's (4th char P).

Every field and document is valid on its own, but the bank account already belongs to existing vendor V-0001 (Orbit Office Solutions). Classic payment-fraud pattern: escalate internally, neutral message to vendor.

GSTIN is registered in Karnataka (29) but the billing address is in Pune, Maharashtra. Not fraud by default: businesses hold one GSTIN per state. Ask for the Maharashtra GSTIN or a confirmed Karnataka billing address.
PAN card uploaded in the GST certificate slot. Document classification catches it; vendor is asked for exactly that one document.
Same vendor resubmits with the correct GST certificate. Only the failed check needs to re-run; outcome moves PENDING -> APPROVED.
